args.question: Cobalt Labs has one approved invoice: INV-34357 for $19,007.30 (wire and ACH both available; bank verified). This exceeds the $10,000 threshold, so controller approval is required. Do you approve sending a wire of $19,007.30 from the operating account to pay INV-34357 in full?
